title: Log reward transaction with complete details
gherkin:
Feature: Reward and Penalty Audit Logging
  Scenario: Log reward transaction with complete details
    Given a user is eligible for a reward
    When a reward is granted to the user
    Then an audit log entry is created
    And the audit log contains the reward amount
    And the audit log contains the timestamp
    And the audit log contains the user identifier
    And the audit log contains the reward reason
rationale: Ensures that reward transactions are properly logged with all necessary details for audit purposes, enabling traceability and compliance verification.
generationSummary: Comprehensive test suite for reward and penalty audit logging functionality, covering logging of reward transactions, penalty transactions, audit trail integrity, and system compliance with audit requirements.

title: Audit log entries are immutable
gherkin:
Feature: Reward and Penalty Audit Logging

    When an attempt is made to modify the audit log entry
    Then the modification is rejected
    And the original audit log entry remains unchanged
rationale: Ensures audit log integrity by preventing modification of historical records, which is critical for compliance and forensic analysis.
